# tritonctl session

Inspect and end live tunnel sessions

Subcommands: list, kill

Usage: `tritonctl session [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl session list

List live tunnel sessions

Usage: `tritonctl session list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl session kill

End a live tunnel session

Usage: `tritonctl session kill [OPTIONS] <ID>`
